--- select_is_unknown.sql
SELECT true IS UNKNOWN, true IS NOT UNKNOWN

--- AST
&ast.QueryStatement{
  Query: &ast.Select{
    Results: []ast.SelectItem{
      &ast.ExprSelectItem{
        Expr: &ast.IsUnknownExpr{
          Unknown: 15,
          Left:    &ast.BoolLiteral{
            ValuePos: 7,
            Value:    true,
          },
        },
      },
      &ast.ExprSelectItem{
        Expr: &ast.IsUnknownExpr{
          Unknown: 36,
          Not:     true,
          Left:    &ast.BoolLiteral{
            ValuePos: 24,
            Value:    true,
          },
        },
      },
    },
  },
}

--- SQL
SELECT TRUE IS UNKNOWN, TRUE IS NOT UNKNOWN
